name: Last Ditch
source:
Far away in the hills beyond most other lands is a small town called Marverence: a strange but peaceful city cloaked in a warm golden sky. The townsfolk will welcome anyone with open arms. They'll speak of their fine shop, wonderful food, and insist for travelers to stay a night or two. But those wise enough will leave quickly,  because there's an open secret shared between the people. They're preparing themselves for the End of the World.

Forced to leave her old city, a young woman named Ambra has found herself living in the town for a while now. Even though the End of the World is upon them, she finds herself feeling good and excited. Why? Because she finally gets to meet YOU, the most recent visitor to the town of Marverence.

[from [url=https://jmluvsbob.itch.io/last-ditch]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
远离大多数其他土地的山上有一个名叫马维伦斯的小镇：一座奇怪但宁静的城市，笼罩在温暖的金色天空中。镇民们会张开双臂欢迎任何人。他们会谈论他们精美的商店、美味的食物，并坚持让旅行者在这里住一两个晚上。但那些足够明智的人会很快离开，因为人们之间有一个公开的秘密。他们正在为世界末日做好准备。

一位名叫安布拉的年轻女子被迫离开她的故城，她发现自己在城里生活了一段时间。尽管世界末日即将来临，她发现自己感觉良好且兴奋。为什么？因为她终于见到了你，马维伦斯镇的最新访客。

[来自[url=https://jmluvsbob.itch.io/last-ditch]itch.io[/url]]
